evidence.claim: A lemon balm leaf extract cream shortened and eased recurrent herpes labialis episodes.
evidence.test_article_detail: cream with 1 % Lo-701 (70:1 dry aqueous extract of Melissa leaf), topical, 5 days
evidence.outcome_summary: Lower combined symptom score than placebo on day 2 (n = 66).
evidence.note: EMA considered this product's data not transferable to a general monograph [8].

md.claim: A lemon balm leaf extract cream shortened and eased recurrent herpes labialis episodes.
md.outcome_summary: Lower combined symptom score than [placebo](#term:placebo) on day 2 (n = 66).

evidence.claim: Single doses of a lemon balm methanol extract changed attention and self-rated calmness in healthy volunteers.
evidence.outcome_summary: Improved quality of attention and increased calmness under laboratory stress in small crossover studies (n = 18-20), as summarised by EMA.
evidence.note: Primary papers not read here; extracts not covered by the HMPC monograph.

md.claim: Single doses of a lemon balm methanol extract changed attention and self-rated calmness in healthy volunteers.
md.outcome_summary: Improved quality of attention and increased calmness under laboratory stress in small [crossover studies](#term:crossover) (n = 18-20), as summarised by EMA.

evidence.claim: An open study of a standardised extract reported lower anxiety and insomnia scores.
evidence.test_article_detail: Cyracos (30 % ethanol extract), open-label, no control
evidence.outcome_summary: Anxiety manifestations -18 %, insomnia -42 % (n = 20; uncontrolled), as summarised by EMA.

md.claim: An [open study](#term:open-label) of a [standardised extract](#term:named-extract) reported lower anxiety and insomnia scores.
md.outcome_summary: Anxiety manifestations -18 %, insomnia -42 % (n = 20; uncontrolled), as summarised by EMA.

evidence.claim: Lemon balm leaf is traditionally used for mild stress, sleep and mild digestive complaints.
evidence.outcome_summary: EMA: 'for relief of mild symptoms of mental stress and to aid sleep'; 'for symptomatic treatment of mild gastrointestinal complaints including bloating and flatulence'.
